external_research_delta.source: Sharma, Dawes, Raval (2026), Dissociating Decodability and Causal Use in Bracket-Sequence Transformers, arXiv:2604.22128
external_research_delta.project_implication: A representation can be cleanly decodable while having weak causal use. Trigger-2 must not promote C/J-Space competence from probe accuracy alone; causal-use intervention and task behavior need separate gates.

external_research_delta.source: Deng et al. (2026), Causal Probing for Internal Visual Representations in Multimodal Large Language Models, arXiv:2605.05593
external_research_delta.project_implication: Recognized/encoded relations can fail to trigger the procedure required for reasoning. For Xeno/EntityOS this supports an explicit REPRESENT -> USE/ROUTE -> EXECUTE diagnostic rather than equating state representation with cognitive-process execution.

external_research_delta.source: Armstrong, Ayoobi, Mukherjee (2026), Decodable But Not Detachable: Training Data Granularity Determines Parametric Modularity in Large Language Models, arXiv:2608.10214
external_research_delta.project_implication: High decodability can coexist with weak localized causal modularity; token-level training granularity can materially shape modularity. Transfer to a 0.8B Xeno target is unverified, so use this as a curriculum-design hypothesis rather than a positive label.

h_represent_use_execute.hypothesis: The finished Xeno cognitive substrate needs three independently measurable properties for each critical process family: semantic state is REPRESENTED/decodable, that state is causally USED for routing/update, and the correct procedure is EXECUTED across family-disjoint contexts.
h_represent_use_execute.counterhypothesis: If end-to-end behavioral accuracy and retention are high, a separate causal-use gate adds complexity without improving generalization.
h_represent_use_execute.cheap_discriminator_after_p0: For a small frozen pilot, jointly measure probe/readout, causal intervention/patch-or-lesion effect, and end-to-end process behavior on the same family-disjoint cases. Reject competence when representation is decodable but intervention does not selectively affect the intended process or when procedure execution remains at shortcut baseline.
h_represent_use_execute.training_implication: Keep C-class decodability as a component metric, but do not let it substitute for B/D/E causal-use and process-execution gates.

h_lineage_proof.hypothesis: Git-object-bound producer lineage will eliminate a class of self-consistent but unverifiable source-authority receipts without changing valid A02 baseline behavior.
h_lineage_proof.counterhypothesis: Current source SHA plus trusted authority file is already sufficient; Git-object binding adds operational brittleness without meaningful epistemic gain.
h_lineage_proof.cheap_discriminator: Mutation-test the current gate with a syntactically valid nonexistent commit SHA. Current code should accept the lineage-format subcheck; the repaired gate must reject before producer invocation while the real b9f38b0d lineage still passes.
